description:
20/20 is an American television newsmagazine that has been broadcast on ABC since June 6, 1978. Created by ABC News executive Roone Arledge, the show was designed similarly to CBS's 60 Minutes but focuses more on human interest stories than international and political subjects. The program's name derives from the "20/20" measurement of visual acuity.

The hour-long program has been a staple on Friday evenings for much of the time since it moved to that timeslot from Thursdays in September 1987, though special editions of the program occasionally air on other nights.

The U.S. and India both have democracy, but only one is prosperous. Natural resources? Hong Kong and the U.S. are both prosperous, but only one is rich in natural resources. videos.title: Gabby Petito: Her Parents Speak Out
videos.overview: A new interview with Gabby Petito's parents reveals what we haven't heard before about the case.

videos.title: Mountain of Lies
videos.overview: A mother plunges from a cliff in a fatal fall while hiking in the Rocky Mountains on her anniversary. For the first time, her daughter speaks out.

videos.title: The Code Breakers
videos.overview: David Muir investigates how cutting-edge forensic DNA technology has led to long-awaited justice in two murder cases that remained unsolved for decades.

videos.title: You Left Me For Dead
videos.overview: Two women shot while asleep in their home – one miraculously survives to tell her story.

videos.title: Dirty Little Secret
videos.overview: The death of Kari Baker, a Texas minister's wife, left a church community shocked and her family convinced it was foul play.

videos.title: Family Lies?
videos.overview: Newly obtained investigative files provide fresh insight into one of New England's most notorious mysteries, which unfolded after Nathan Carman and his mother Linda Carman took a fateful fishing trip in 2016. Was it lost at sea...or was it murder?

videos.title: Sex, Knives, and Videotape
videos.overview: A beloved celebrity hairstylist is found murdered in his own home in 2017. Was it a burglary gone wrong or something more sinister? His family searches for justice and answers. Who killed Fabio?

videos.title: Unlucky Numbers
videos.overview: When Abraham Shakespeare wins $30 million in the Florida lottery in 2006, he is generous with his winnings, helping friends, family, and strangers. But three years after his windfall, Shakespeare mysteriously vanishes. Police begin an investigation, and there is no shortage of possible suspects.

videos.title: The Rose Petal Murder
videos.overview: When Christina Parcell's body was discovered in her South Carolina home in October 2021, the gruesome crime scene also featured a strange clue—mysterious rose petals scattered around the house. Later, another unexpected clue leads to a courtroom confession that no one saw coming.

videos.title: Blood on the Door
videos.overview: 21-year-old Johnia Berry was pursuing a master's degree in psychology at the University of Tennessee when an intruder entered her apartment, stabbing her and leaving her to die. For years, the case went cold, but Johnia's mother kept fighting for justice.

videos.title: Sherri Papini: Where the Truth Lies
videos.overview: Sherri Papini, the woman who captivated the country by faking her own abduction, speaks out in a new documentary for the first time.

videos.title: Road Map to Murder
videos.overview: Bart and Krista Halderson, a married couple in Windsor, Wisconsin, go missing in 2021. After their remains are found, a clue from social media changes the entire course of the murder investigation.

videos.title: I Have Killed For You
videos.overview: Bonnie Woodward, a beloved 47-year-old mother of four, goes missing from her workplace parking lot in Alton, Illinois, in 2010, while her teenage stepdaughter is also missing.

videos.title: Karen Read: The Verdict
videos.overview: The girlfriend of a beloved Boston police officer learns her fate in the murder case that captivated the country across two high-profile trials.

videos.title: They Know Everything
videos.overview: A killer puts a complex scheme into play after murdering University of Florida freshman Christian Aguilar. A new investigation unearths the lengths taken to bury the truth.

videos.title: Idaho Justice
videos.overview: This episode delves into the high-profile case of the University of Idaho murders. It uncovers new details about the crime, the evidence collected, and the shocking guilty plea entered by the accused, Bryan Kohberger. The episode includes exclusive interviews with the families and friends of the victims.

videos.title: First Comes Love, Then Comes Murder
videos.overview: When a wife and mother named Leslie Preer was killed in her house in Chevy Chase, Maryland, in the spring of 2001, shockwaves were sent across the entire community. Her loved ones had to wait for justice for more than two decades until the detectives apprehended the killer using an advanced DNA technology. The investigation revealed a dark truth that connected the killer to the Preer family.

videos.title: 21 Days To Murder
videos.overview: Exclusive interviews and new evidence in the shocking case of a Colorado dentist accused of murdering his wife by poisoning her protein shakes.

videos.title: He's Right Behind You
videos.overview: Who would want to kill Kristil Krug, a mom of three kids? Follow the clues in a race against time to catch a deadly stalker.

videos.title: What Happened to the McStays?
videos.overview: In 2010, Joseph and Summer McStay and their two young sons vanished from their Fallbrook, California, home. For nearly four years, the family’s fate remained unknown—until a grim discovery in the Mojave Desert turned the missing persons case into a homicide investigation.

videos.title: Life on the Line
videos.overview: 21-year-old mother Denise Amber Lee disappears from her North Port, Florida, home. Follow the real 911 calls as they unravel in this life-and-death case.

videos.title: Driven to Death
videos.overview: In Horry County, South Carolina, Gregory Rice's disappearance in early October 2020 sparked a search that eventually uncovered a secret affair.

videos.title: Lost in the Night: Who Murdered Jessica Currin?
videos.overview: In Mayfield, Kentucky, 18-year-old single mother Jessica Currin was brutally murdered in 2000. The case haunted the town for years until a jury convicted Quincy Omar Cross in 2008. What began as a local tragedy has become a national conversation about truth, power, and accountability as Cross's claim of a wrong conviction gains momentum.

videos.title: The Murdaugh Family Murders
videos.overview: The Murdaugh family once held deep roots in South Carolina’s Lowcountry, where generations served as top prosecutors and wielded influence across legal and political circles. But behind the prestige was a web of corruption, financial crimes, and ultimately, murder.

videos.title: You Took My Daughter
videos.overview: At Fort Bragg, North Carolina, 24-year-old mother and Army maternity ward nurse Holly Wimunc suddenly vanished in July 2008. At her apartment, coworkers reportedly found smoke damage and signs of an intentionally set fire. While detectives scrambled to find her, her father, halfway across the country, was just learning his girl was gone.

videos.title: I'm Going to Get You
videos.overview: A college student is murdered in her home, and while investigators work the case, evidence from a string of sexual assaults leads to a break; a survivor who helped authorities catch the killer speaks out for the first time;

videos.title: The Final Cut
videos.overview: A beloved hairstylist vanishes without a trace, launching a multistate investigation that ultimately uncovers a chilling trail of deception.

videos.title: Ride or Die
videos.overview: After 24-year-old mother Alyssa Burkett is brutally shot and killed outside her workplace, real-time surveillance video helps detectives uncover clues that lead to a suspect whose own confession suggests a possible mastermind still at large.

videos.title: Meddler or Murderer?
videos.overview: A wealthy grandmother goes on trial accused in the murder-for-hire of a family member.

videos.title: Badass Detective
videos.overview: A dogged detective will stop at nothing -- donning disguises, going under cover, and employing cutting edge forensics -- all to solve the murders of two young women

videos.title: The Hunt for Mr. Right
videos.overview: From Mr. Right to most wanted: Investigators uncover the double life of an international fugitive.

videos.title: Her Last Note
videos.overview: When Jessie Blodgett, a talented teen musician, is murdered in her home, another young woman is brutally attacked nearby, and one link that helps police catch the killer.

videos.title: What The Killer Left Behind
videos.overview: A mother's unwavering crusade for justice after her daughter's murder and the hidden clue that helped catch a killer living in plain sight.

videos.title: Footprints in the Snow
videos.overview: In Blue Mountains, Ontario, first responders find a burned-out car with one victim inside, and the married couple who own the car are both missing. Police are left to untangle what happened as they search for answers and a possible killer.

videos.title: The Au Pair, the Affair and Murder
videos.overview: After a young mother is found murdered, seemingly at the hands of a home intruder, investigators uncover a far more intricate plot than the initial evidence suggests.

videos.title: Yogurt Shop Murders
videos.overview: Four teen girls are found murdered in a Texas yogurt shop. Decades later, DNA evidence and advanced forensics reveal a suspected serial killer.

videos.title: Murder at the U
videos.overview: When Bryan Pata, a college football player destined for the NFL, is murdered, his mother questions whether police have done enough to solve the case. 20/20 and ESPN investigate.

videos.title: The Vanishing of Nancy Woodrum
videos.overview: A wedding weekend turns into a real-life whodunit when the vacation rental's host vanishes overnight.

videos.title: Murder, She Wrote: The Kouri Richins Trial
videos.overview: The shocking story of Utah mom Kouri Richins, accused of poisoning her husband and then writing a children's book about grief. The verdict is in. Her closest friend and a jury foreperson speak out

videos.title: The Neighbor From Hell
videos.overview: A disgruntled neighbor, Susan Lorincz, shoots and kills Ajike Owens, sparking national outrage. Exclusive "20/20" interviews and body camera video document the bitter feud and its aftermath.

videos.title: One Last Call
videos.overview: A family drama unravels during a twisted murder plot involving veteran firefighter Robert Doerr. Police uncover a shocking clue from the funeral that leads to an unlikely killer.

videos.title: Death of a Showgirl
videos.overview: Debbie Flores Narvaez, a beautiful Las Vegas showgirl, disappears without a trace. Who knew the dark secrets of what happened?

videos.title: The Secret in the Water
videos.overview: A mysterious house fire caught on camera leads investigators to the unsolved murder of 25-year-old mother Regina Rowe Hicks, found in her car submerged in a pond.

videos.title: Tracking Susana
videos.overview: On a hot summer night in 2022 in Gwinnett County, Georgia, 16-year-old Susana Morales was visiting her friend's house when she seemingly disappeared. A tracking app on Susana's phone gave intriguing clues, but the search went on for months. Her family wouldn't stop until they found answers.

videos.title: Murder Next Door
videos.overview: Kay Parsons, 41, was a Georgia mother who was found severely beaten in her Grovetown home on March 25, 2009, and died the following day. Initially, investigators considered it a tragic home invasion, but soon uncovered a tale of betrayal and planned violence.

videos.title: Evil at the Door
videos.overview: When 19-year-old Kenia Monge goes missing and 30-year-old Lydia Tillman is found beaten in a nearby town, detectives learn that one of the victims holds the answers to both crimes in her hand.

videos.title: Stalking Samantha: 13 Years of Terror
videos.overview: A Michigan woman's survival story after being kidnapped by a man who stalked her for years and built a secret bunker to hold her captive.

videos.title: Her Last Call
videos.overview: After a young mom is abducted from her home, it will take a series of chilling 911 calls, including one from the victim herself, to solve the case. Her family speaks out in a new "20/20" interview.
